name: HB Fuller Co
business: Formulates and sells industrial adhesives, sealants and specialty chemicals to packaging, hygiene, medical, electronics, automotive, aerospace and construction manufacturers worldwide.

events.what: Recommended cash acquisition of Advanced Medical Solutions Group plc (UK surgical adhesives), 285p per share, equity about GBP 659M, EV about GBP 715M, about $300M revenue; expected to add about 100 bps to EBITDA margin within 24 months and about $55M run-rate synergies by 2031. Announced, pending, close expected before fiscal year end. The sec-api Item 1.01/2.01 query missed this filing (items 1.01, 2.03, 7.01, 9.01)
events.source: 8-K 0001437749-26-021844 (EX-2.1, document_id 74113, announced 2026-06-25); close timing per CEO, document_id 224337

events.what: Investor Day: >20% EBITDA margin roadmap, Project Quantum Leap footprint program (82 plants to 55, about $75M annualized savings by end of 2030)
New independent directors (board to nine); separately a director resigned and a former UFP Technologies CEO joined
events.who: Celine Martin (2025-12-01); R. Jeffrey Bailly replacing Ruth Kimmelshue (2026-09-23)

events.what: No CEO or CFO change since 2024-07-01 (CEO Mastin since December 2022, CFO Corkrean since May 2016). Chair Lee Mitau retired 2025-01-21, outside the window. Shareholder pressure raised on the Q3 2026 call; CEO said a divestiture is being taken 'very seriously' to delever
events.source: 8-K 0001437749-24-031581; 10-K FY2025 executive officers table (data_profile description); document_id 224337

next_event.source: Last Investor Day 2025-10-20 (document_id 50571). Next dated item is the AMS close, guided 'before year-end' (fiscal year ends late November), document_id 224337; no new framework update promised

margin_framing.metric_basis_note: Level and year from the CFO at the 2025 Investor Day: above 20% by end of 2028 (about 200 bps from Quantum Leap, 100 to 150 bps from mix, about 50 bps from pricing over five years; about 50 bps in 2026). Dollar savings with a year from the CEO: about $75M Quantum Leap savings by end of 2030 (about $25M by end of 2026, $20M to $25M more in 2027). AMS synergies $55M by 2031 sit on top and were announced after the 20% roadmap. FY2026 guide: adj. EBITDA $655M to $670M, excluding AMS.

statements.quote: As we move forward, the cumulative impact of these drivers will continue to build, driving our EBITDA margin from approximately 18% this year to well above 20% in the next five years, eclipsing the 20% level by the end of 2028 based on our current estimates.
statements.speaker: John Corkrean

statements.quote: We continue to target approximately $75 million of annualized conversion cost savings by the end of 2030.
statements.speaker: Celeste Mastin

statements.quote: Through disciplined execution, we delivered strong revenue, EBITDA, and EPS growth in the quarter and continued to improve profitability and advance toward our EBITDA margin target of greater than 20%.
statements.speaker: Celeste Mastin

street.gap_assumption: Same metric. Fiscal year ends late November, so Baba FY labels equal company fiscal years (Baba FY2028 = fiscal 2028). Gap uses 20.0% for '>20%' against FY2028 consensus (782.0M / 3,982.7M). Only 3 brokers. Unclear whether consensus includes AMS (company guidance excludes it); if not, the AMS +100 bps would widen the gap. first_stated is null: the >20% target was raised from 'high teens' on the Q4 FY2023 call (document_id 92199, fiscal period Q4 2023), date not fetched; times_repeated counts calls where the target was seen in search hits (Q4 2023, Q3 2024, Q4 2024, Q2 2025, Investor Day 2025, Q3 2026).

evidence_of_progress.note: Order is [Q2 2026, Q3 2026]. Q2 181.0M / 950.3M vs 165.7M / 898.1M (Baba consensus actuals); Q3 record 19.9%, up 80 bps, on $938M revenue and $187M adj. EBITDA (8-K EX-99.1 0001437749-26-031113, document_id 224288). Driven by 7.4% pricing against petrochemical raw material inflation plus restructuring savings, with volume down, so part of the gain is price-cost timing rather than structural.

verdict: Best numeric framing of the four (>20% by end 2028, $75M savings by 2030), but no leadership change, the street is only 36 bps short and the AMS deal is the real catalyst.
open_questions: Does the 3-broker consensus include AMS; if not, does the target-year gap widen to about 100 bps or more once AMS is modelled?
How much of the Q3 2026 record 19.9% is price-cost lag from the petrochemical disruption that reverses when raw materials fall (a commodity-margin check)?
Will shareholder pressure produce a divestiture or a leadership change (CEO said divestiture is taken 'very seriously'), which would add the missing catalyst leg?
